maria-devex: Heads-up — proposal to add a client-side `rate_cap` + short-lived affinity handshake in SDKs to reduce server-side quota spikes.

aj-eng: Can you sketch the handshake? curious about compatibility with existing headers.

maria-devex: short sketch:
```
Client -> POST /v1/requests
Headers: X-Redwood-Client-RateCap: 50, X-Redwood-Affinity: init, X-Redwood-Affinity-V: 1
Server -> 200 { affinity_id: "af_123", ttl: 30s }
Subsequent requests include X-Redwood-Affinity: af_123
``` 
Intended: temporary affinity helps keep requests routed to same pool for KV cache locality and prevents cross-customer bursts. rate_cap is local safety valve.

sam-platform: hmm. affinity_id TTL is key. we don't want stale affins routing to overloaded nodes.

lee-ts-sdk: TS SDK can add a RetryPolicy + local token-bucket limiter quickly. opt-in flag default off for now?

nina-py-sdk: Python SDK can expose `client.rate_cap` param. but we need a graceful fallback when server doesn't return affinity.

omar-go: Go SDK should avoid goroutine leaks with token bucket. also need docs for multi-process environments (gunicorn) — local limiter per-process is ok but we should document.

elaine-product: If default is opt-in, adoption might be low. what's the product tradeoff?

maria-devex: goal is conservative rollout: opt-in in SDKs + console toggle for orgs. then canary for high-volume customers via account flag.

aj-eng: telemetry: we need new metrics: `client.ratecap_applied`, `affinity.success`, `affinity.expiry`, and tag by sdk/lang + sdk_version. Console needs dashboards for these.

srebot: INCIDENT-TRACER: note that any affinity-induced hot shards must be visible via shard_cpu and affinity_count metrics.

sam-platform: console UX: add a per-organization "Client Ratecap" tile with histogram for observed client-side caps vs server-side throttles. also show percent of requests with active affinity.

lee-ts-sdk: question on header names: prefer `x-redwood-client-ratecap` and `x-redwood-affinity` to avoid generic collisions.

aj-eng: agree with prefix. also we need to version header: `x-redwood-affinity-v=1` so we can evolve.

nina-py-sdk: backwards compat: if header not present, server behaves same. if affinity present but unknown, server should drop it and return new affinity.

omar-go: telemetry export should include `affinity_id_len` to detect entropy issues, and warn if collision >0.

elaine-product: rollout plan: 1) implement headers + opt-in in SDKs 2) console toggle + dashboards 3) enable for 5 pilot customers 4) evaluate SLO impacts 5) flip opt-in default after 8 weeks. sounds ok?

maria-devex: sounds good. action items:
- lee, nina, omar: PRs for SDKs adding flags + local limiter (due EOD Fri)
- aj: server header parsing + telemetry + affinity id TTL handling (PR by next Wed)
- sam: console tile mockups (by Tue)
- product: pick pilot customers (elaine)

lee-ts-sdk: I'll open draft PR and an RFC in repo.

nina-py-sdk: will add tests for process-shared behavior and env var to disable limiter.

omar-go: will add benchmarks for limiter overhead.

elaine-product: I'll email pilot invites and prep a runbook for pilot.

aj-eng: one more: correlate affinity with model variant and route to ensure caches are valid.

maria-devex: thanks all. calling this thread resolved for planning. :thumbsup:

srebot: DeployBot: staging cluster deploy started for rfc/client-ratecap branch
